Alex — great to meet today. Thanks for the time and for walking through Acme's latency/cost goals. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Summary: You’re evaluating a hosted + dedicated hybrid to keep latency under 150ms for customer-facing features and to isolate PII-sensitive flows.
- What we sent: attached pricing deck and tailored estimate (Redwood_Acme_Estimate_20260612.pdf + Redwood_Pricing_Deck_20260612.pdf). The estimate includes a 12-month Dedicated commit with burst capacity and an initial onboarding package.
- Ask/next step: Can we lock a 30–45 min walk-through next week to run through the estimate line-by-line and any procurement questions? I’ve penciled in availability on Mon/Tue mornings PT but can flex to your schedule.

If you prefer, I can loop in our procurement lead (Marissa) for procurement/contract questions — she’s cc’d.

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198)

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Deck_20260612.pdf (16 pages, deck), Redwood_Acme_Estimate_20260612.pdf (estimate PDF)

Thanks Sean — got the deck and the estimate, appreciate the clear breakdown. I’m looping in Natalie (ops) to confirm on the compliance side. We’re reviewing internally this week and I should have a sense of timing by early next week.

- Can the hosted portion be scoped down for the first 2 months while we ramp?

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Alex — thanks for the quick note and the questions. Short answers below, happy to walk through in the call: 

- Dedicated commit refundability: We typically offer usage credit protection in year-one MSA addendum rather than cash refunds — happy to have Marissa share standard language.
- Hosted ramp option: Yes — we can configure a lower initial hosted tier for months 1–2 and automatic scale rules. That’s already reflected as Option B on page 6 of the estimate.

Would you like to schedule the 30–45 min walkthrough tomorrow or early next week? I’m flexible Mon/Tue morning PT. If helpful, Marissa can cover contract/terms on the call.

Best,
Sean
